name: codeforge
description: Code Forge — Win98-styled coding school with the Paperclip AI tutor. Zero-dependency Node server: static site + POST /api/paperclip.

scripts.content:ansible: node scripts/build-ansible-curriculum.js && node scripts/enhance-ansible-core.js && node scripts/inject-ansible-videos.js
scripts.lab:build: docker build -t codeforge-ansible-target:local labs/ansible/target && docker build -t codeforge-ansible-controller:local labs/ansible/controller
scripts.lab:up: npm run lab:build && docker compose -f labs/ansible/compose.yml up -d --no-build
scripts.lab:reset: docker compose -f labs/ansible/compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f labs/ansible/compose.yml up -d --build
